events_in_stated_order.kjv: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.

events_in_stated_order.event: The jailer and all his household are baptized
events_in_stated_order.kjv: And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, straightway.
